    start = 0
    maxLength = 1

        low = i - 1
        high = i + 1
        
        # Expand around the center for odd length palindromes
        while low >= 0 and high < n and S[low] == S[high]:
            if high - low + 1 > maxLength:
                start = low

                start = low
